title: A short amphipathic peptide-based injectable hydrogel with antibacterial properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24566-24574
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03481G, Paper

Dorien Aerssens, Atiruj Theppawong, Hue Vu, Petra Rigole, Marleen Van Troys, Tom Coenye, Richard Hoogenboom, Steven Ballet, Charlotte Martin, Annemieke Madder
Antibacterial peptide hydrogels were prepared by merging a short peptide hydrogelator sequence with a short antibacterial peptide sequence. The resulting thixotropic biogels were evaluated by means of an in vitro wound model.
